title: Route a SaaS access request (Acme policy v2.1)
spec: Implement route_request(tool: str, access: str, *, customer_data=False, financial_data=False, production=False, external_sharing=False) -> str.
Return exactly one of 'auto_approve', 'needs_manager', 'needs_security', following Acme's SaaS Access Policy v2.1 (data/acme/saas_access_policy.md), simplified:
- Approved tools: Jira, Confluence, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Miro, Figma, GitHub. Tool names are compared case-insensitively, ignoring spaces around them.
- access is one of read, standard, write, paid_seat, admin (case-insensitive, spaces around ignored). Any other value -> raise ValueError.
- needs_security if ANY of: access is admin, production, customer_data, financial_data, external_sharing.
- otherwise needs_manager if ANY of: the tool is not approved, access is write or paid_seat.
The strictest track always wins: needs_security > needs_manager > auto_approve.
